evals.prompt: This folder is my household paperwork archive. Some of it is already filed, but the loose scans at the top level aren't. Organize the loose files the same way as the rest. I trust you on this one: show me the plan, then go ahead and apply it without waiting for me.
evals.expected_output: The skill surveys the folder, learns the existing pattern (company folders, 'YYYY-MM-DD - Company - Description' names, Northwind statements dated by the statement period end), reads each loose file, and presents a plan before applying it. scan_0001.txt becomes 'Acme Power/2023-03-14 - Acme Power - Statement.txt'. scan_0002.txt becomes 'Northwind Bank/2023-02-28 - Northwind Bank - Checking Statement.txt', matching the existing description wording and period-end dating. scan_0003.txt goes to a new 'Contoso Dental Group' (or 'Contoso Dental') folder dated 2023-04-02 as an invoice. 20240105093012.pdf is dated 2023-06-09 from its printed invoice date, not the 2024 scan timestamp in its filename, and goes in the same Contoso folder as scan_0003.txt. Nothing is deleted, no existing file is overwritten, the file count stays at 6, and a log of the moves is written somewhere outside a temporary directory.
expectations: scan_0001.txt ends up in the existing 'Acme Power' folder named '2023-03-14 - Acme Power - Statement.txt'
scan_0002.txt ends up in the existing 'Northwind Bank' folder with a name starting '2023-02-28 - Northwind Bank - ', using the statement period end date like the existing Northwind file
scan_0003.txt is named with the date 2023-04-02 and a Contoso Dental category, and is filed in a folder named for Contoso Dental
20240105093012.pdf is named with the date 2023-06-09 from its printed invoice date, not a 2024 date from the scanner filename
Both Contoso files are filed in the same folder, with the same category spelling in their names
The workspace still contains exactly 6 files after the run, and the two pre-existing files are unchanged and in place
A plan listing each old and new name was shown before any file was moved
A record of the moves (old and new paths) was written to a file that is not under /tmp or another temporary directory

evals.prompt: Can you figure out good names for the files in this folder? Just propose the names for now, don't rename anything yet.

IMG_20240611_101500.txt is a receipt printed 07/02/2019 with prices in dollars, so it is dated 2019-07-02 with the US reading stated as an assumption rather than asked as a question; the 2024 camera timestamp is ignored. notes-from-scan.txt has no date anywhere, so the skill falls back to the file's creation date and says that the date is the creation date. Every file keeps its original name.
expectations: doc1.txt is proposed with the date '2019-03' (month precision, no day)
doc2.txt is proposed with the date '2018', the tax year the form covers
IMG_20240611_101500.txt is proposed with the date 2019-07-02, not a 2024 date from the filename

notes-from-scan.txt is proposed with a date taken from the file's creation date, and the response says that date is the creation date because the document has none
Each proposed name follows 'date - category - description' with ' - ' separators and a category naming the issuing company
No file in the workspace was renamed or moved

evals.prompt: reminders-export.json is an export of my Reminders lists. They've gotten messy. How would you organize them? Don't change anything, just give me a plan.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes Reminders as a forward-looking collection where reminder text is content: it does not rename any reminder and does not add dates to reminders or list names.
